claims.summary: For m >= 2, M0 = 3m-3, window start w = C(m,2)+3m: assume (S) an order-six operator L = sum_(s<=6) P_s(M) S^s annihilates the three pair sequences g_ij of lem:cube-level-window-reduction for M >= M0, with P_6 nonzero at integers M >= w, P_0 nonzero at integers 3m <= M < w, and P_s(M0+t) = 0 for s <= 2-t, t = 0,1,2; and (I) the g_ij restricted to M >= 3m are independent. Let u be the solution of L on M >= 3m with u = 0 on the window and u(w+5) = 1, and c_t(x) = sum_(s >= 3-t) P_s(M0+t) x(M0+t+s). If U_3 has rank < 3 then c_0(u) = c_1(u) = c_2(u) = 0; conversely when the c_t are independent on the solution space.
